newsitem.title: JAPAN: Sony slightly lower after earnings report.
newsitem.headline: Sony slightly lower after earnings report.

text.p: Shares in Sony Corp eased slightly on Friday morning, after hitting a new record high soon after the opening on its robust earnings results for 1996/97.
The share price touched a new all-time high of 9,830 yen, backed by its record profits for the last business year announced late on Thursday. But it later fell on profit-taking.
At 0052 GMT, the electronics giant's shares were 50 yen lower at 9,670 yen. Its turover of 1.6038 million shares was the ninth-heaviest on the first section of the Tokyo Stock Exchange.
"The market took the earnings report favourably. But as with other high-tech issues, the yen's rise weighed on it," said a broker at a "Big Four" securities house.
On Thursday, Sony unveiled record group profits for 1996/97 business year, aided by robust global sales and a weak yen, and predicted further growth in the current year.

Sony's group net profit was 139.46 billion yen in the financial year to March, up 2.6-fold from the year before. Parent current profit was 85.73 billion yen, a three-fold increase from the previous year.
